run_clustering_pipeline: run the main clustering pipeline via fire CLI to fit UMAP and HDBSCAN or KMeans models on text data using Ray
generate_embeddings_from_jsonl: generate text embeddings from a JSONL input file using a sentence transformer or LLM model and save to parquet
fit_umap_and_hdbscan_remotely: run the remote Ray task to fit UMAP dimensionality reduction and HDBSCAN clustering models on embedded data
transform_embeddings_with_umap: transform existing embeddings using a fitted UMAP model to produce lower-dimensional UMAP embeddings for clustering
fit_kmeans_on_embeddings: fit a KMeans clustering model on UMAP-transformed or raw embeddings using a configurable number of clusters
